facts.material: mixed: electric drill, worklight, charger, battery, bits, nylon bag
facts.function: drilling with a rechargeable cordless drill; worklight and accessories support it
facts.form: retail set of different articles put up together

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8467 tools for working in the hand, with self-contained electric motor; set is prima facie in several headings (8467 drill, 8513 worklight, 8504 charger, 4202 bag)
GRI 3(b): retail set; the cordless drill gives the essential character
GRI 6: 8467.21 drills of all kinds, battery powered, chuck capacity under 12.7 mm (assumed)

rejected_alternatives.reason: worklight is a minor component, not the essential character
only for hand tools of headings 8202-8205 sets; drill is a powered tool of 8467
applies if chuck capacity is 12.7 mm or more
other than drills; H86275 multi-tool kit went there but this set is drill-led

missing_facts: chuck capacity of the drill (under 12.7 mm assumed)
classification.rationale: A drill with its battery, charger, bits, light and bag is a retail set under GRI 3(b); the drill imparts essential character so 8467.21 battery powered applies. H86275 (in_force) treated a similar cordless kit under heading 8467 per GRI 3(b), though its components differed (drill, jigsaw, sander), so it only supports the approach.
